notes.title: Let's celebrate World Animal Day with Animal Week! 🥳
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋

We are excited to announce that our game is a part of Animal Week on Steam, starting today until October 10, 2024! 😻 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/acbfcdb9ad6540118cb53041410bc50decc2f9e8.png

This special event is organized to celebrate World Animal Day and aims to raise awareness about animal welfare and conservation. During Animal Week, our game will be featured alongside a diverse selection of animal-themed games, offering players unique experiences that highlight the beauty and importance of the animals and environment worldwide.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2658510/view/4660753243321301287

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44666157/6407467d84d8cac0ff8bec4fca835c71f4296b0d.png

We are proud to support efforts to protect wildlife and their habitats by participating in this event. This initiative promises to provide an educational and entertaining experience for all players. 🤝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/eb19fe493d76b11305b4420230767da78aeeadac.png

As part of our commitment, a portion of the revenue generated from our game during Animal Week will be donated to animal welfare organizations. 🥰

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/e7160665a65210e6cdcc6e8bb638baef925e3d4a.png

The main partner of Animal Week is WWF Poland, a leading conservation organization, that brings their extensive expertise in wildlife protection and environmental sustainability. Their involvement in this event underscores the shared commitment of both organizations to foster a deeper understanding of animal conservation issues among the gaming community.

Read more about helping the TIGER 🐯 click the banner below 👇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/0f02d1c40abac7b658288ca99db9557afc693ce7.png

Think globally act locally 🌍

Let’s make a difference together through the power of gaming! 🦸‍♂️🦸‍♂️ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44823070/91f3a34156d093b6bf3cf365dcaa294e9aff9a56.png

Have Fun!!
Games Incubator Team

notes.title: Full Version - RELEASED! 🛒
notes.content:
Get ready to open your pet shop! 🛒 

Customers are already waiting to visit your store - arrange it, fill the shelves and wait for the first customers 🏬


We’re proud to announce that the Pet Shop Simulator is Now Available to Play! 🎊

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/

[previewyoutube=L5E8Sks8Mwk;full][/previewyoutube]

After all the months of hard work, the Pet Shop Simulator is ready, and you can now enjoy the game now! 💪 The entire team worked really hard during the development, ensuring the game met your expectations. Your feedback was invaluable at every stage of the production - we have analyzed your ideas and suggestions - thank you for that. 🤝

We also want to extend our heartfelt thanks to every one of you - our amazing community - for all the support and passion we have received from you - from the demo stage to the full version. Without you, we wouldn’t have had the motivation to push forward and strive to give you the best we can. ❤️‍

With that being said, there is not much left to do but to invite you to purchase the full version and enjoy the fruits of our labor through several hours of amazing gameplay! 🎉

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
Exciting news! 🐾 
The new Pet Shop Simulator Prologue update is now available!

We're happy to announce that the game is getting another batch of things you've been asking for and fixes for those bugs you've reported. 
The king of this update is definitely the new rabbit model 🐰 

Before update: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867481/11d415f401b9dbf76aaef56ee0196bd99d117a82.png

After update:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867481/f18fa809042247558cd1d7ee06ea52e5dc9e0dcc.png


Here's a quick look at what's coming:

Fixes and improvements:


 Fixed the saving of fish data.
 Resolved the problem of products locking up at checkout.
 Faster cleaning of cages and aquariums.
 People now leave less mess on the floor.
 Improved rabbit model


Get ready to return to the world of pet shopping management with these improvements! Stay tuned for more details and unleash your inner pet store entrepreneur. 🐶🐱🐠 

See you soon,
Pet Shop Team

notes.title: Update | No Limits!
notes.content:
You’ve been consistently asking us to lift the three days limit for each individual playthrough for the Prologue version. This was the most frequently mentioned topic throughout the entire feedback. 📝

We are happy to see your thirst to develop your shops more and enjoy the gameplay.


We do listen to your requests and as of today the limit has been lifted! 🤩

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867481/94bc99301f42483ceddff46ce0c50af43b08a615.png


You can enjoy the playthroughs to your heart's content! 👍 We’d like to thank everyone who already tried the Prologue and invite those of you who still haven’t to give it a try! 🐰

We’re grateful for all your feedback so don’t forget to give us your opinions, ideas and suggestions in the discussion section or on our discord! 👇 If you enjoyed the Prologue, don’t forget to add the full version to your wishlists on Steam to not miss out on the Premiere. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401680/Pet_Shop_Simulator/ 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44867481/80de79fb1c7ccb47fb450644539326d1208b5527.png

See you soon,
Pet Shop Simulator Team
